image-gen.name: Image generation
image-gen.description: Enable to let the Keeper generate occasional player-visible scene, portrait, or item handouts through the configured external image provider.

mature-mode.name: Mature mode
mature-mode.description: Enable for a private, invite-only adult or romance campaign whose players have explicitly opted in. It lifts the Keeper's self-censorship for explicit romance or intimacy scenes and the room's adult user-written lore while it is on.

module-forge.name: Module forge
module-forge.description: Enable to let the Keeper author a brand-new module or scenario from a natural-language description and install it into this room's module knowledge. Turn this on only when you want the Keeper itself to generate and install a new module at your request.

romance-relationships.name: Romance & relationships
romance-relationships.description: Enable for a campaign centered on romance or intimacy: tracks attraction and tension, resolves seduction and reading feelings as social checks, and prompts consent beats before a scene turns intimate.

rule-forge.name: Rule forge
rule-forge.description: Enable to let the Keeper author a brand-new TTRPG rule system from a description of its sheet and checks. Turn this on only when you want the Keeper itself to generate and install a new rule system at your request.

skill-forge.name: Skill forge
skill-forge.description: Enable to let the Keeper author a brand-new KP skill from a natural-language description of a desired play-style. Turn this on only when you want the Keeper itself to generate and install new skills at your request.

svg-mapmaker.name: SVG mapmaker
svg-mapmaker.description: Enable to let the Keeper draw simple player-visible SVG handout maps: location maps, room hierarchy diagrams, clue-route sketches, and relationship or area structures with labels.
